With specified vertex order (10,3,0,2,7,11,1,9,5,4,6,8), independent sequential toggle yields 428 and 211 matched pairs. Every reversed Hasse incidence belongs to an acyclic directed graph (topological sorts cover all 863/455 nonempty faces). Critical cells are (one 0,three 3,three 4) and (one 0,thirty-two 3). The exact signed 3x3 Morse boundary from four- to three-cells is entirely zero; with 3-skeleton a wedge of three S3, Hurewicz/π3 classification makes four-cell attaching maps null; the other matching has no adjacent higher cells. Therefore the integral homotopy wedges, not just Betti numbers, follow. Independent mod-two Betti computations agree. Scope is two finite graphs, and enumeration is exhaustive.
